reviews.review: ☄️ Well, this is truly the closest thing to L4D, but players haven't given it a chance, which is a shame. With gradual content updates and polish, this would've been a solid project. Still, I wasn't expecting anything special, but it's fun! Guns, temporary upgrades, special aliens, even the extra modes - everything works as it should. The retro-futuristic space environment looks great (and I'm not even a big fan of that!) If you have someone to play with, this is a not that bad buy (especially with a big discount). It's possible to play solo, but the AI ​​can be a bit odd at times, though teammates aren't useless (it's been worse, even in bigger titles). Of course, this is a modest game by the standards of the genre. It should have been released much earlier and not been abandoned, but calling it bad is a really big stretch.
i buy it for 1 euro and i want my money back
